row: B19 S5: admin-created invite links for humans-only Team Space (create, list, preview, redeem, revoke)
providers: Atum platform company authority and Shell native routes

base.rule: additive minor version: every 1.1 wire byte is kept and answered unchanged; this pack adds the invite-link actions selected by Atum-Company-Wire: 1.2 with schemaVersion 3 for its own messages. The 1.1 pack is not edited

selection.additivity: under 1.2 every 1.1 request and answer is byte-identical to its 1.1 answer, including schemaVersion 2; only the messages this pack adds carry schemaVersion 3

response_marker.scope: the invite-link messages of this pack

selection.probe: POST /api/matrix/v1/invite-links/preview or GET /api/matrix/v1/companies/{companyId}/invite-links: a 1.1 server answers 404 before authentication
selection.cache: no-store on every answer to a 1.2 request

token.entropy: at least 32 bytes from a CSPRNG
token.generation: server-side only; a client never sends or chooses one
token.projection: only the first create answer (replayed false) carries it, inside link.url; a create replay, list, preview, redeem and revoke answer never does
token.at_rest: only a keyed hash of the token is stored (SHA-256 with a server-side pepper held outside the database, or an equivalent salted hash), keyed by link id; lookup compares in constant time; the raw token is never stored, logged or recoverable, so a database read, backup or replica yields no usable link
token.replay: because the raw token is not stored, a create replay cannot re-emit url: it answers the link metadata with replayed true and no url; an admin who lost the first answer creates a new link, and may revoke the old one from its list row

creation.authorization: only a current active, non-revoking effective admin creates or replays a create; this includes the single owner introduced by 1.3, which older wires project as admin; adminship is re-checked on every call, so a demoted, removed or revoking caller is 403 matrix_403 with no url and no link metadata
creation.replay: replay scope is (actor, requestId): the same admin and requestId answers the same link metadata with replayed true and no url; a different actor under the same requestId is 409 matrix_409 and never returns the first actor result; the same actor reusing the requestId with a different expiry or maxUses is also 409 and changes nothing; a role other than member is refused by the request shape as 400 before a replay is reachable (only member exists), so a changed role is never a 409
creation.resend: a bearer-link resend or rotation is revoke plus create: revoke the old link, then create with a new requestId, link id, token, expiry and use counter; no operation recovers, extends or reuses the old secret
creation.live_links: a company holds at most 20 live links (state active); authorization is checked before this cap, so a caller who is not a currently active, non-revoking admin gets 403 matrix_403 even when the company is at the cap and never learns the live-link count; a create at the cap by an active admin is 409 matrix_409 with details.reason invite_link_limit_reached
creation.rate: an admin creates at most 10 links in any rolling hour; authorization is checked before the rate exactly as it is before the live-link cap, so a caller who is not a currently active, non-revoking admin gets 403 matrix_403 and never 429; beyond the rate an active admin gets 429 matrix_429 with details.reason invite_link_rate_limited

audiences.admin: the first create answer carries the url; list answers carry metadata for every link of the company and never the url
audiences.member: list answers are empty; a member cannot create or revoke
audiences.holder: preview shows the company, the role and the inviter after sign-in; redeem joins

link_projection.state: displayed state precedence: revoked if the link was revoked or the company is retired, else expired if now >= expiresAt, else exhausted if uses >= maxUses, else active; a retired company therefore never displays active, even when the link itself is live
link_projection.ownership: the link belongs to the company; it survives its creator leaving and any current active non-revoking admin can revoke it
link_projection.inviter: the creating admin current handle and displayName, or both null once that person is not an active member

order: authenticate the actor and check person eligibility before replay lookup; removed, revoking and non-human principals receive the uniform 404 even for a stored requestId
look up the replay by (actor, requestId)
link is active, not revoked, not expired, not exhausted, company active for a first execution
quota locks in global order target-person quota, company, invite-link; then the person own-company cap and company member cap
create and accept, or accept an existing invited row
consume exactly one use only if the link created the membership row
redemption.replay: replay scope is (actor, requestId), after current person eligibility: an eligible same actor, requestId and token is answered from the stored result with replayed true, consumedNow false and the current usesRemaining, even after the link was revoked or exhausted; a removed, revoking or otherwise ineligible person receives the uniform 404 before receipt lookup; a requestId already used by a different actor is 409 matrix_409 and never returns another actor stored result; the same actor reusing a requestId with a different token is 409
redemption.use: a use is a successful joining that the link created; a preview, a replay, an already active member, an accept of an existing invitation and any refusal spend none
redemption.atomicity: link state, use count and membership change in one transaction; quota locks are acquired in one global order: target-person quota, company, invite-link; a proven SERIALIZABLE equivalent must cover both membership predicates; the last use admits exactly one person and a revoke concurrent with a redeem yields either redeem-then-revoke or revoke-then-unavailable
redemption.caps: the target-person quota lock serializes one human joining different companies, the company lock serializes different people joining one company, and the invite-link lock serializes use and revoke; every redemption that may create or accept membership uses the global target-person quota, company, invite-link order (or a proven SERIALIZABLE equivalent over both membership predicates), so concurrent redeems cannot overshoot companies_per_person or members_per_company
redemption.pending_removal: a person in revoking is never previewed, redeemed or re-added by a link; preview and redeem both answer the uniform invite_link_unavailable
redemption.pending_attempt: when a 1.3 direct invitation attempt is pending, link redeem atomically accepts that exact attempt, transitions it to terminal accepted, and consumes no link use; it never leaves an invited member_state because invited belongs to the invitation attempt, not the member row
redemption.removed: removal and ban are sticky for links: a removed person is never previewed or redeemed through a link, and both preview and redeem answer the uniform invite_link_unavailable with no company name, inviter, expiry or liveness; only a direct handle invitation from an active admin readmits them and restores no project grant; removing a person does not revoke other people links
redemption.first_channel: redeem answers with the membership; the client opens the company and default channel through the 1.1 snapshot and channel directory

revocation.actor: any current active, non-revoking effective admin, including the single owner introduced by 1.3; every revoke call, including a replay, re-checks that authority and answers 403 matrix_403 with no link metadata otherwise
revocation.idempotent: a same-actor replay of the same requestId answers revoked with replayed true; a requestId already used by a different actor is 409 matrix_409; a different requestId after revocation answers revoked without changing the first revokedAt
revocation.effect: immediate for new previews and redemptions; joins that already happened stand and people who joined are not removed
revocation.precedence: revoked (including a retired company) wins over expired and exhausted in the displayed state

redaction.server_logs: record route templates, never the concrete path, query or body; error logs and traces redact token and every /j/<token> substring; no metric label, analytics event or support bundle carries one
redaction.response_headers: Cache-Control: no-store, Pragma: no-cache and Referrer-Policy: no-referrer on every link answer
redaction.landing_page: Referrer-Policy: no-referrer, no third-party script, no analytics, Cache-Control: no-store, token not rendered as text and removed from the address bar with history.replaceState after the handoff
redaction.api: the token travels in the JSON body of preview and redeem, never in a path or query
redaction.clients: the pending token lives in memory or the platform secure store, never in a journal, log, crash report, analytics property or chat message

errors.invite_link_unavailable: one 404 body for every unusable link: unknown or malformed token, revoked, expired, exhausted, retired company, capacity, ineligible principal, and a removed person or a person in revoking on preview or redeem
errors.invite_link_limit_reached: create refuses with 409 matrix_409 and details.reason invite_link_limit_reached when the company already holds live_links_per_company live links
errors.invite_link_rate_limited: create refuses with 429 matrix_429 and details.reason invite_link_rate_limited after creations_per_admin_per_hour creations by the same admin in a rolling hour
errors.changed_input: a replay whose requestId is reused by a different actor, or by the same actor with a different expiry, maxUses or token, is plain matrix_409 and changes nothing; a changed role never reaches replay because the create shape admits only member and refuses anything else with 400

platform_to_native_v1_2_create.to: authenticated native client (Atum-Company-Wire: 1.2), the one answer that projects a link
